name: Create New File From Text
description: Create a new file from plain text. [See the documentation](https://developers.google.com/drive/api/v3/reference/files/create) for more information

configurable_props.name: drive
configurable_props.label: Drive
configurable_props.description: Defaults to `My Drive`. To select a [Shared Drive](https://support.google.com/a/users/answer/9310351) instead, select it from this list.

configurable_props.name: parentId
configurable_props.label: Folder
configurable_props.description: The folder you want to add the file to. If not specified, the file will be placed directly in the drive's top-level folder.

configurable_props.name: name
configurable_props.label: File Name
configurable_props.description: The name of the file you want to create (e.g., `myFile.txt`)

configurable_props.name: content
configurable_props.label: Content
configurable_props.description: Enter text to create the file with.

configurable_props.name: mimeType
configurable_props.label: Conversion Format
configurable_props.description: The [format](https://developers.google.com/drive/api/v3/ref-export-formats) in which the text is presented
